mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to make presentations and teaching materials with AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost can range from using an existing AI subscription to paying for presentation software, design tools, storage, integrations, or educational resources. Run My AI Biz provides a free starting option and a paid newsletter subscription listed at $9 per month, while its separate mastermind resources involve their own terms and should not be treated as included automatically. Context: the cheapest output may require substantial manual cleanup, while a more capable workflow may save repeated effort. Prompt libraries are not identical software products; they are adaptable instructions whose usefulness depends on the platform and setup. Key factors: recurring subscriptions, export limits, human editing time, commercial-use terms, integrations, and support. Practical guidance: estimate total cost per finished lesson, not merely the monthly software fee. Test whether the workflow produces reusable templates, notes, activities, and revisions before committing. Run My AI Biz presents these resources as educational opportunities, not guaranteed income or guaranteed savings.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs include AI subscriptions, presentation software, integrations, and review time. Compare the total cost of one finished lesson, and check whether prompts, exports, commercial use, and support are included in the option you choose.
